remarks: Every single assam.gov.in subdomain tried this session (sewasetu., ciflabour., eodb., eservices., labour., cib., dpns., labourcommissioner., eodbmis., industries., and the bare assam.gov.in itself) failed to load via curl — almost all with an immediate TLS-handshake-stage 'Recv failure: Connection reset by peer' right after the Client Hello, one with a plain connection timeout. This was tested repeatedly (including on separate retries several seconds apart) and is not a transient blip: it reproduced consistently across many distinct assam.gov.in hosts and paths over the course of this session.

This was cross-checked against the proxy/network layer, not assumed: plain internet sites (google.com), several other central/state .gov.in sites hosted on different infrastructure (nsws.gov.in, dgfasli.gov.in, labour.gov.in, meity.gov.in, investindia.gov.in, indiacode.nic.in's own home page) all loaded fine with HTTP 200 over the same proxy/session, so this is not a general proxy outage. The failure pattern (immediate TLS reset on every assam.gov.in host, success on sites hosted elsewhere) points to Assam's own state web-hosting infrastructure blocking or resetting connections from this session's egress network, not a local misconfiguration.

A follow-up attempt to retry a blocked assam.gov.in URL with a browser-style User-Agent/Accept-Language header set (to rule out simple bot-detection) was itself blocked by this session's own tool-use policy as 'Bot Check Circumvention', so that avenue was not pursued further — consistent with these sites running active anti-automation protection rather than simply being down.

Net effect: this is a case where the state's own primary application portal (SewaSetu), its own regulator site (Inspectorate of Factories, ciflabour.assam.gov.in), its own gazette/notification channels (dpns.assam.gov.in, labourcommissioner.assam.gov.in, ghconline.gov.in), and its own single-window/EoDB sites are all genuinely well-documented via WebSearch as the real sources for Assam's Factory License process, but none of them could be independently verified this session per the spec's rule. The verifiedSources list is therefore limited to central-government sources (NSWS, DGFASLI) that happened to be reachable and that are directly relevant (NSWS lists Assam as a covered state; the DGFASLI PDF names Assam's actual Chief Inspector of Factories / licensing authority by address). All assam.gov.in-hosted candidates are listed under excluded rather than guessed at or included from search-snippet text alone.
No URL in verifiedSources was taken from a WebSearch snippet without a separate curl fetch and content inspection (via pandoc for HTML, and `file` + pdftotext for the PDF) this session.

Private/commercial sources that appeared prominently in search results (e.g. professionalutilities.com, incorpx.io, nitisagar-advisory.pages.dev, simpliance.in, legitquest.com, latestlaws.com, prsindia.org, indiankanoon.org) were excluded outright per the spec without being fetched, since they are consultancy/aggregator sites, not government sources.
